reviews.text:
It's rare to find a pet hotel that my dog ​​is happy to go to, so I'm truly grateful 🐶

Being able to check on him via camera 24/7 is reassuring, and I always look forward to seeing the cute photos and carefully written logs you send me each time 🥰

I can always feel the love and care you give him, and it's a hotel that both my dog ​​and I love ✨

Thank you so much for everything, and I look forward to continuing to use your services 🥰

The staff's journals are wonderful, and I look forward to reading them every time!

They play with the dogs according to their personalities, and you can really tell that all the staff love dogs 🐶

It's also great to be able to see expressions and behaviors of my beloved dog that I don't usually see through the journals!

Not only is it a place where I can leave my dog ​​with peace of mind, but it's also a wonderful daycare/pet hotel where I look forward to leaving my dog ​​there ♡

We always appreciate the care our dog receives at the daycare and hotel 🐶✨

First of all, the play area, individual rooms, and entrance are all incredibly clean! We've never experienced any unpleasant odors, which are often a concern in pet facilities.

And most importantly, the staff are all incredibly kind, and their love for dogs is evident ♡
They carefully monitor not only our dog's usual behavior but also any subtle changes in their health, so we feel completely at ease leaving our dog there for extended periods or overnight stays.

What we always look forward to is the daily log they write about our dog's day! It's detailed and entertaining, so we enjoy reading it every time 😂
The photos they include are always so cute, we have to save them 📸♡

We also frequently use the hotel, and we appreciate that each room is private. Furthermore, each room has a pet camera that connects to our smartphone, allowing us to check on our dog's stay anytime. Being able to see our dog anytime during their stay gives us great peace of mind as a pet owner.


From the cleanliness to the kindness of the staff, their love for dogs, and their meticulous attention to detail, I feel completely at ease leaving my beloved dog in their care. ☺️
I hope to continue using their daycare and hotel services in the future.

I use their services about five times a month.

All the staff are incredibly kind and pleasant, so I always feel at ease leaving my dog ​​there. ☺️

I also appreciate them sending photos and videos, and I'm truly grateful for the attentive service at only 1,000 yen per hour!

It's been a huge help, and my dog ​​always seems to enjoy it, which makes me happy too. Thank you so much! ✨

☆We're using their daycare subscription service 🐶

We're so grateful that they look after our child from 8 am to 8 pm, and we're especially thankful that they take our child outside for potty breaks since he can't do them indoors.

Also, we always look forward to the staff's daily logs; the photos really convey how our child spent his time.

(I think the fact that he's able to play with children who are a good match for his personality is because they're being properly looked after.)

It's a daycare where we can leave our child with peace of mind!

Thank you for everything, and we look forward to continuing to use your services.

We are always grateful for the care you provide at the daycare.

Your photography is excellent, and I enjoy looking at the photos along with the daily log!

It's so clear that all the staff love our dog, which gives us peace of mind when leaving him there. 🐶✨

Our dog feels so comfortable there that he even sleeps on his back with his belly exposed; it's like a second home for him. 🏠🌱

We use a subscription-based daycare service. My child loves the nursery (and the staff) and is always excited and happy to go there. As soon as she arrives and sees the staff, she immediately rolls over on her back, doesn't even look back at her owner (me), and is often very affectionate (lol).
The staff always writes adorable daily journals about what happened while my child was there, and I often read them aloud at dinnertime, and my whole family enjoys looking at the photos and seeing what happened that day. Thank you so much for always showering my child with love and affection. We look forward to continuing to use your services.

I'm so grateful for the subscription service; my dog ​​Kiki is looked after three times a week, from 8 am until after 7 pm. The staff are all genuine dog lovers and treat her so kindly that she looks forward to going to the shop every time and always goes in willingly.

I was looking for a daycare center because I didn't want to leave my dog ​​home alone as much as possible, and I found this one near my workplace, so I'm using it now 🐶

Many other daycare centers only accept dogs until around 6 PM, which is difficult for me given my work schedule, but this one keeps my dog ​​until 8 PM, which is a huge help!

The staff are all very kind, and even my dog, who can be quite stubborn, is happy to be pulled along to the center every time 😊

He's still a little wary of other dogs, but I'm so impressed with how much better he's become at greeting them during walks ✨

I highly recommend this daycare center to anyone looking for one!!!

I'm always grateful that they're open from early in the morning until late at night.

It's clear that everyone at the shop takes good care of my dog.

This is a very attentive and reassuring pet hotel.

This was our fifth stay, and we've always felt completely at ease leaving our pet in their care.

They took lots of photos and videos, and it was reassuring to see how much fun our pet was having.

Also, the long operating hours, from 8 AM to 8 PM, are incredibly helpful.

We would definitely like to use their services again.

As a foreigner, and because my Japanese isn't very good yet, I was very nervous about using the service for the first time. However, the staff were incredibly welcoming, and I quickly felt at ease.
I was worried that my dog, Maru, would be scared in a new place, but to my surprise, he was overjoyed and happily ran around with the other dogs! Seeing him like that filled my heart with joy 🥹
Also, they kindly accommodated my last-minute change of pick-up time, which was a huge help.
I was deeply moved by the staff's loving service, the clean and safe environment, and above all, by how genuinely happy the dogs seemed. I would definitely like to use their services again next time. Thank you so much! 🐾✨

I use their subscription service 🐻‍❄️
I've used several daycare centers before, but I've finally found the one I feel most comfortable leaving my dog ​​in!
When I pick her up, she comes out with a happy look on her face, which makes me happy knowing she had a fun day ☺️ They send me a daily log and photos of her day, which is reassuring 🥰 The log is so well-designed, I look forward to reading it every time 💘 The staff have all been there for a long time, so I think it's a great place for both dogs and staff 🐶🙋🏻‍♀️
They open early in the morning, which is a huge help for me since I have a job ☀️
I definitely want to continue going to this place 🤝

From the first time I used the service, I received very kind and pleasant service. 
The store is also clean and very nice. 
Thank you as always.

This is a trustworthy daycare center with excellent consideration for pet owners!

I use this daycare through a subscription service, and it's incredibly convenient and reassuring. Both the owners and staff are very friendly, and I feel comfortable talking to them about any concerns I have.

• [Flexible service] Being able to choose a time that suits me, between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM, is incredibly convenient. It's also incredibly helpful that reservations, diary entries, and photos can all be completed via LINE.
• [Promptness] The diary and photos are always delivered to me when I pick up my child. I love being able to review the day's progress as soon as I get home. At other daycare centers, this can sometimes take hours or the next day...
• [Quality] The staff are amazing at taking photos! They capture many better expressions than owners could (lol). The diary entries are also carefully written and I look forward to reading them every time.
• [Meticulous health management] It's a little-known but much appreciated feature that they not only tell me the number of times my child poops, but also their condition in detail. I feel at ease knowing their health is well-understood.

Not only does it have a comfortable environment for dogs, but the interior is always clean and stylish, and it's also designed with ease of use for pet owners in mind, making it a truly recommended nursery school!

This is a subscription-based daycare that allows my dog ​​to attend 20 days a month. Most daycares have short opening hours, so I'd have to give up on leaving my dog ​​at work. However, this one is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, so I can leave him there while I'm at work.
He plays a lot at daycare before coming home, so he sleeps a lot at home, which is really helpful!
After picking him up, I receive a daily diary with photos and videos. I can see how my dog ​​spent the day and how he interacted with his friends, which is really heartwarming. ♡
My dog ​​also likes the teachers (staff) at the daycare, so he's happy to go to school. Spaces are limited, so if you're interested, I recommend inquiring early.

February 2026 Update
These are my impressions after more than a year of using their services. I don't have a subscription, but I use their temporary daycare service 1-2 times a month.

My dog ​​loves TURN-A. When I say, "We're going to TURN-A today," she does a dance of joy and pulls on the leash as we approach the shop, eager to go. She's very attached to all the staff, and I'm surprised that the owner handles everything personally. I haven't seen this level of service at other salons.

Regarding overnight stays, I used to be anxious and insisted on having someone on duty at night, but they're easy to talk to and flexible, and I feel that unattended stays are fine if the dog is accustomed to it beforehand.

Also, the fact that everything can be handled through the LINE app is great. Other salons often require you to fill out paper forms on your first visit, even if you enter your personal information online or through their app, which is a hassle.

Everything is wonderful, from the staff to the system. I want to continue using their services until my dog ​​reaches the age limit.

October 2024 Post
I used their temporary daycare service for the first time recently.

I researched and compared many pet hotels, but this is the most ideal No. 1!

* You can visit the hotel (many hotels don't allow visits)
* They customize meal and walk times (many hotels have fixed times)
* They let dogs play with other dogs (most hotels don't allow interaction to prevent problems)
* Reservations are easy to make on your smartphone
* I appreciated being able to register my dog's profile in advance (my dog ​​would get restless with paper forms, making it difficult to write quickly)
* It's unmanned at night, but the operating hours are long and there are 24-hour monitoring cameras
* The photo log is great
* What I liked most was the private room. I liked that it was enclosed so my dog ​​couldn't see people or other dogs.

And above all, they were kind and courteous, and when I went to pick up my dog, he had completely warmed up to them. I was surprised! I want to bring him here often.

The staff's service was excellent, and being able to check on the dog via video gave me peace of mind.
Some might think it's a bit expensive, but personally, I don't think it's too expensive considering the attentive service you receive from staff who love dogs.

I always ask you to look after my dog ​​for short periods.

My dog ​​prefers people to other dogs, but she always seems happy because you treat her so kindly.

I always enjoy looking at the photos and videos you send after the service. Thank you for your continued support!
